summary.result: In this study, a practical object oriented finite element analysis program, OOFE_ JAVA was developed and the result of the analysis on a rectangular clamped plate was shown.
summary.background: The finite element analysis program should be prepared to deal with many of newly arising engineering problems.
summary.method: And a virtual machine which Java language is using can be loaded on any kinds of computer which has java interpreter regardless of the platform on which the OOFE_JAVA was developed.
